spec_match.rationale: Demonstrates verbatim the spec note the feature's default rests on — "Empty datagrams are lost, and min loses message delineation" — using the same two stream kinds datagrams.readable can be.

interactive.rationale: One button feeds three datagrams through a real default stream and a real byte stream; every rendered row (per-read sizes, the engine's enqueue TypeError, the fused min read) comes from the streams engine, not scripted output.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index blurb promises the empty-datagram refusal and the min-merge on the same three datagrams; the two lanes deliver precisely that.

edge_cases.rationale: The empty datagram and boundary-spanning min are themselves the edge cases; a browser without read(view,{min}) support is caught and reported honestly in the verdict rather than mislabelled.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus, the spec member and its note, and the Streams read(view,{min}) definition.

conformance.rationale: The suite's manual empty-datagrams-preserved-live assertion pins the live half of this contract, and the executable byte-stream assertions pin the reader-mode halves; verified 3 pass / 3 fail / 1 blocked on Chromium 141.

runtime_evidence.rationale: This page's contract is local streams behaviour, fully executable here: headless Chromium 141 via the repo CDP harness (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this environment) drove the run at 1280×900 and 360×740 — lane A read 5/0/7 bytes preserving all three messages, lane B threw the engine's TypeError at the 0-byte enqueue and fused HELLO+GOODBYE into one 12-byte min read; clean console/network, overflowX 0, screenshots read on both classes.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts the expected lane outcomes (reads=3, sawEmpty, enqueueError present, merged) and reports failures verbatim; no dangling readers.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables only; kept/lost/merged rows use emerald/rose borders with explanatory text; the model badge is black-on-ivory.

accessibility.rationale: Datagram chips and read rows are lists with full text; the verdict is one polite live region; the single control is a native button.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Driven at both classes with 0px horizontal overflow; read rows wrap monospace content; both screenshots read.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible live region status readout for async API probe result
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: One polite live region per surface with meaningful, final announcements.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The verdict output is the page's single live region, written once per run with the full two-lane conclusion; per-read rows are static list items added before the announcement.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive stacked result lanes without horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Single-column grids with wrapping monospace content for result logs.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Both lanes are single-column lists with overflow-wrap:anywhere; 0px page overflow at 360px.

summary: The spec's own note, executed: a real default stream preserves three datagrams including the empty one; a real byte stream refuses the empty message at enqueue (engine TypeError) and fuses the other two inside one min read. Fully verified on Chromium 141 with the repo headless-Chromium CDP harness (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this cloud environment); clean console/network, 0px overflow both classes.
